history.p: The University of Copenhagen started planning their four hundredth anniversary during the summer of 1878. The Senate wanted two cantatas: one for the feast of conferring degrees at the University, and one for the ceremony in Vor Frue Kirke. Gade and Christian Richardt were asked to write the former, whereas J.P.E. Hartmann as the long standing organist of Vor Frue Kirke was obliged to compose the latter cantata in collaboration with Carl Ploug.

physDesc.physMedium: 1 bifolio and 4 single folios. Written in ink.

Bound in brown cardboard cover with leather spine. On the front cover a handwritten label inscribed: "Festmusik i Solennitetssalen / Partitur". On the paste-down Gade has written: "Componeret til Universitetets / 400 Aars Jubelfest. / Opført i Solennitetssalen / d. 5 Juni 1879. / 22 Sop: 18 Alt: 20 Ten 25 Bassi (Studentersangforeningen). / (Mindre Orchester). [Gade's musical signature]". Written in ink. Paper: 18 staves. At the end of the music on p. 127 end-dated and signed: "Fine 4 Mai 1879" and Gade's musical signature.
